title: Divine Auras in Play
heading: Divine Auras in Play
summary: Describes how mundane people, magi, faeries and infernal beings experience a Divine aura. Useful for adjudicating the reactions of characters who enter the Dominion or an Empyreal aura.
quotes: The Dominion auras of different faiths, such as Christianity, Islam, or Judaism, or others such as Zoroastrianism, Catharism or Gnosticism, have no different game effects.

title: Who Has the Dominion?
heading: Who Has the Dominion?
summary: Explains which groups of worshippers are protected by a Dominion, regardless of creed, and notes that heresy may cause schism.

title: Dominion Power
heading: DOMINION POWER
summary: Rules of thumb for how strong the Dominion is and how far it extends from a place of worship, in a church, a city and the surrounding land.
quotes: the Dominion is typically strongest where people gather to worship in a consecrated place (aura 4)

title: Dominion Power Examples
heading: Dominion Power Examples
summary: A quick table of Dominion aura ratings by kind of area, with adjustments for night and holy days.
quotes: At night, subtract one from the rating, and add one on holy days (Sundays for example).

title: Holy of Holies (the Eucharist)
heading: Holy of Holies
summary: Describes the Dominion radiated by the consecrated Eucharist in Christian churches, how it fades with distance, and what destroys it.
quotes: The Eucharist radiates a Dominion (not Empyreal aura) of five until the next Good Friday; this aura decreases by one every five paces

title: Conflicting Auras
heading: CONFLICTING AURAS
summary: Says how the Dominion fares against another realm's aura of equal or greater strength, with an example of a church built on a faerie site.
quotes: the Dominion will trump the opposing aura; a more-powerful aura will still overwhelm the Dominion

title: Creating a Dominion Aura
heading: CREATING A DOMINION AURA
summary: Procedure for founding a Dominion: a celebrant, a consecrated site and a congregation, two successful Dominion rites, and then how the aura grows, fades and exceeds the usual maximum.
quotes: **DOMINION RITE:** Communication + Theology (or Dominion Lore) + stress die vs. Ease Factor 6
Dominion ratings higher than five are achieved through extremely holy objects, or the relics of particularly exemplary saints

title: Empyreal Auras
heading: Empyreal Auras
summary: Explains Empyreal auras as Divine auras that arise without a congregation, from relics, saints or divine creatures, and states that they work the same as the Dominion in game terms.
quotes: There is no difference, system wise, between Empyreal auras and the Dominion.

title: Empyreal Aura Power
heading: EMPYREAL AURA POWER
summary: How to rate an Empyreal aura from Faith Points, miracles or the lair of a divine creature.
quotes: Empyreal auras from miracles have a rating of one point for every five levels of miracle above 50.
up to a maximum rating of his Divine Might divided by 10

title: Divine Regiones
heading: Divine Regiones
summary: Introduces Divine regiones as holy pocket realms, how they come into being, and the two kinds, terrestrial and celestial.

title: Terrestrial Regiones
heading: Terrestrial Regiones
summary: Describes terrestrial Divine regiones, which are holy versions of a real place and typify a virtue.

title: Inside Terrestrial Regiones
heading: INSIDE TERRESTRIAL REGIONES
summary: What visitors find inside a terrestrial regio, including how potent levels can yield vis from ordinary things.

title: Celestial Regiones
heading: Celestial Regiones
summary: Describes celestial regiones as unfixed spiritual realms of angels, entered mainly by invitation.

title: Inside Celestial Regiones (Celestial Disorientation)
heading: INSIDE CELESTIAL REGIONES
summary: Rolls and penalties for mortals who enter a celestial regio, and the limits on prolonged exposure that lead to Fatigue loss and Warping.
quotes: **OVERCOME CELESTIAL DISORIENTATION:** Stamina + Dominion Lore + stress dice
**CELESTIAL DISORIENTATION EASE FACTOR:** Regio Rating x3
**PROLONGED EXPOSURE LIMIT:** Stamina + Parma Magica (or similar Ability) + 3

title: Creating Divine Regiones
heading: Creating Divine Regiones
requires: Divine creature with sufficient Divine Might
summary: Rules for divine beings with enough Divine Might creating temporary Divine regiones, and the Might cost of sustaining them.
quotes: Divine beings with a Divine Might score of 20 or greater have the ability to create temporary Divine regiones of either kind.
The creature must spend at least 10 Divine Might points, which creates a single-level regio with a rating of 1.

title: Spontaneous Regiones
heading: SPONTANEOUS REGIONES
requires: A miracle, holy power or expenditure of Divine Might
summary: Notes that powerful divine acts may create a temporary Divine regio, with no precise system beyond story needs.

title: Divine Beings
heading: Divine Beings
summary: Defines a divine being as any creature with Divine Might and describes where such beings live and how they interact with humans.

title: Nephilim
heading: Nephilim
summary: Describes the Nephilim, half-angelic giants, including their longevity, immunity to disease and need to eat prodigiously.

title: What Are Angels?
heading: What Are Angels?
summary: Defines angels as the spiritual inhabitants of Heaven with Divine Might, their membership of a single Choir, and where each Choir tends to be found.

title: Angelic Choirs
heading: Angelic Choirs
summary: Lists the three Hierarchies and nine Choirs of angels, from most to least exalted.

title: Angelic Traits (overview)
heading: Angelic Traits
summary: Introduces the shared traits all angels have and the extra traits each Hierarchy grants, and how Seferiel from the core book fits.

title: Angelic Traits
heading: ANGELIC TRAITS
summary: The baseline statistics every angel shares: minimum Divine Might, a fixed Personality Trait, the ability to be a conduit for a miracle and obedience to divine law.
quotes: All angels possess the Personality Trait "Love of God" +5.

title: Angelic Powers
heading: ANGELIC POWERS
summary: The three powers all angels have: Angelic Mantle, Enfolding and Envisioning.
quotes: *Angelic Mantle*, 2 points, +12, Corpus

title: Angelic Characteristics
heading: ANGELIC CHARACTERISTICS
summary: How to set an angel's Characteristics: non-physical ones derive from Divine Might, physical ones from a point-buy for its Mantle.
quotes: Angels with 1-10 Divine Might have a +1 in all non-physical Characteristics; angels with 11-20 Divine Might have +2 in all non-physical Characteristics, and so on.

title: Angelic Free Will
heading: ANGELIC FREE WILL
summary: Guidance on how angels act freely but always in accord with God's will, and notes that they can be wounded or destroyed.

title: Angelic Senses
heading: ANGELIC SENSES
summary: Angels perceive directly rather than through senses, so their perception cannot be targeted by spells.

title: Angelic Movement
heading: ANGELIC MOVEMENT
summary: Angels move instantaneously, though in a Mantle they usually move naturally.

title: Angelic Language
heading: ANGELIC LANGUAGE
summary: Angels communicate by illumination, which has a Penetration of zero, so they often speak human languages to magi.
quotes: This speech has a Penetration of zero (modified by any Penetration Ability the angel may have)

title: Angelic True Names
heading: ANGELIC TRUE NAMES
summary: True Names of angels act as arcane connections and aid Penetration for anyone who learns them.
quotes: True Names act as indefinite Arcane Connections, and grant a +5 multiplier bonus to a caster's Penetration multiplier.

title: Angels and Magic
heading: ANGELS AND MAGIC
summary: How Hermetic magic can affect angels in Mantle or in spiritual form, their immunities, and how they can be destroyed.
quotes: angels can be destroyed permanently by reducing their Divine Might to a negative value.

title: Angels, Auras, and Regiones
heading: ANGELS, AURAS, AND REGIONES
summary: What angels automatically know about auras, how they enter regiones, and the Second Sight rating they use to find non-Divine regiones.
quotes: All angels are considered to have a Second Sight Ability score equal to their Divine Might ÷ 5 for the purposes of finding non-Divine regiones.

title: Seraphim (Choir traits)
heading: Seraphim
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Seraphim.
quotes: **Divine Might:** No less than 35
with the level of the effect determined by the number of Might Points spent multiplied by 10

title: Cherubim (Choir traits)
heading: Cherubim
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Cherubim.
quotes: **Divine Might:** No less than 25

title: Thrones (Choir traits)
heading: Thrones
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Thrones.
quotes: The Holy Influence Total of a Throne using this power is equal to his Divine Might ÷ 2

title: Dominations (Choir traits)
heading: Dominations
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Dominations.
quotes: **Divine Might:** No less than 10

title: Authorities (Choir traits)
heading: Authorities
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Authorities, including how Might reflects an Authority's office.
quotes: An Authority responsible for a flower may have Divine Might 5, while an Authority responsible for a thunder storm or a mountain has a Might of 15 or 20.

title: Potentates (Choir traits)
heading: Potentates
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Potentates.
quotes: The cost of the power is equal to the cost of the diabolical power it is opposing.

title: Principalities (Choir traits)
heading: Principalities
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Principalities, including the Might cost scaled to the size of the area protected.
quotes: A family costs 5 Might points, a hamlet or village costs 10, a town or city costs 15, a duchy costs 20, a kingdom or nation costs 30, and an empire, such as Byzantium or the Islamic Caliphate, costs 40 points.

title: Archangels (Choir traits)
heading: Archangels
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by all Archangels.
quotes: **Divine Might:** No less than 50
doing +40 damage to all non-Divine beings (doubled against creatures with Infernal Might), and stripping non-Divine beings of 10 points of Might

title: Angels (Choir traits)
heading: Angels
summary: Minimum Divine Might, Personality Traits and Powers shared by the lowest Choir of angels.
quotes: the angel may modify by 3 (plus or minus) any Personality Trait roll that could result in the target acting virtuously or piously

title: Grigori, the Watchers
heading: Grigori, the Watchers
summary: Describes the Watchers, a tenth Choir cast to Earth and trapped in their Mantle, and how they can be permanently slain.

title: Portraying Angels
heading: Portraying Angels
summary: Advice on playing angels as near-perfect but fallible beings, and on how they appear in an Envisioning or in a disguised Mantle.
quotes: Angels can make mistakes, over- or under-estimate someone, and be outwitted or fooled.

title: Ceremony (group prayer)
heading: CEREMONY\*
summary: Lets a group pray together to boost a focus character's holy effect, with a group modifier based on participants' Ceremony scores, with or without a leader.
quotes: **GROUP MODIFIER:** total Ceremony scores – number of participants

title: Invocation (Holy Method)
heading: INVOCATION\*
summary: The Holy Method of calling on God's power with spoken or written prayer, costing Confidence or Faith and optionally using a stress die.
quotes: This adds Communication to your roll, and requires that you spend a point of Confidence (or Faith) to bring the effect into being.

title: Meditation (Holy Method)
heading: MEDITATION\*
summary: The Holy Method of achieving ecstasy through chanting or performance, with periodic Stamina rolls and a defence against Divine Ascent.
quotes: you must make a Stamina roll every ten minutes against an Ease Factor of 6
You may subtract your score in Meditation from your roll to avoid Divine Ascent

title: Purity (Holy Method)
heading: PURITY\*
summary: The Holy Method of working miracles through strenuous effort, and the rule for extending any holy ritual over hours, days or weeks to spend more Confidence or Faith.
quotes: You must engage in an activity that is strenuous enough to cause you to lose a long-term Fatigue level or suffer a Light Wound, and you use your Stamina for your effect roll.

title: Holy Influence
heading: Holy Influence
summary: How holy characters with spiritual authority inspire temporary Personality Traits in followers, by personal influence over a season or by a short ceremony, with a roll that sets the strength of the trait.
quotes: **HOLY INFLUENCE:** simple die + Presence + Leadership

title: Personality Flaws (treating as traits)
heading: Personality Flaws
summary: States how Personality Flaws are treated as traits when rules involve Personality Traits, so holy influence can oppose them.
quotes: treat a Minor Personality Flaw as a +3 trait, and a Major Personality Flaw as a +6 trait

title: Tempers
heading: Tempers
summary: Rules for holy characters invoking a temper in a Dominion aura, giving bonuses or penalties to compatible or opposed actions, with descriptions of the seven tempers.
quotes: **TEMPERING AN AURA:** stress die + Presence + Leadership

title: Personality Traits (tempers, virtues and vices)
heading: Personality Traits
summary: A table linking each temper to related positive Personality Traits, the vice it opposes and the negative traits, with advice on noting a trait's temper.

title: Schism
heading: Schism
summary: Explains how rival holy leaders invoking different tempers in the same aura can cancel each other out, which is called schism.

title: Invoking God's Aid
heading: Invoking God's Aid
summary: Any character who can spend Confidence or a Faith Point may pray for divine help in an endeavor, with a roll and botch rule for presumption.
quotes: **INVOKING GOD'S AID:** stress die + Communication + Dominion Lore

title: Divine Aid Bonus Table
heading: Divine Aid Bonus Table
summary: Converts the invocation total into a bonus to rolls in the scene, and describes how long it lasts and how group invocations work.
quotes: the bonus will cease to operate as soon as the player fails a roll or at the end of the scene

title: Invoking God's Aid in Warfare
heading: Invoking God's Aid in Warfare
summary: Limits on invoking God's aid in military conflict and how it combines with a Trained Group's combat bonus.
quotes: only the highest Divine Aid Bonus applies to the group's combat bonus

title: The Commanding Aura
heading: The Commanding Aura
summary: Divinely appointed rulers and religious leaders gain Magic Resistance, a Soak bonus and an authority aura, with scores by rank and faith, and how relics and sanctions interact.
quotes: They receive a Magic Resistance score with the value listed below and a bonus to their Soak equal to their Magic Resistance score divided by 5.
In the Latin Christian world, the supreme religious leader is the Pope, with a Magic Resistance of 25.

title: Player Characters and the Commanding Aura
heading: Player Characters and the Commanding Aura
requires: Rank in an ecclesiastical or secular hierarchy
summary: Rules for player characters conferring a commanding aura on others through an investiture ceremony.

title: The Powers of Relics
heading: The Powers of Relics
summary: Common powers every relic has: a Faith score, a Divine Might derived from it, and an aura that harms Infernal creatures, plus how specific powers work and when they fail.
quotes: A relic's Divine Might is equal to the relic's Faith score (or highest Faith score, if more than one applies) multiplied by 10, and is refreshed with every sunrise.

title: Miraculous Effects
heading: Miraculous Effects
summary: The core system for holy characters: combine a Method with a Power to design an effect, roll against its level, and risk a tragedy of hubris on failure.
quotes: **EFFECT TOTAL:** simple die + (Characteristic) + (Method) + (Power) + Aura Bonus
They may substitute their (Faith score x 10) for their effect total when determining if they would suffer a tragedy of hubris.

title: Tragedies of Hubris
heading: Tragedies of Hubris
summary: Table of minor, major and ultimate tragedies that can befall a holy character who fails an effect roll, by how far the total fell short.
quotes: **MINOR TRAGEDY (–1 TO –10)**
**MAJOR TRAGEDY (–11 TO –20)**
**ULTIMATE TRAGEDY (–21 OR MORE)**

title: Methods and Traditions
heading: Methods and Traditions
summary: Describes the three Holy Methods, Invocation, Meditation and Purity, and the Characteristic each typically relies on.

title: Learning Methods and Powers
heading: Learning Methods and Powers
requires: True Faith or an appropriate Virtue
summary: Explains how holy Methods and Powers are learned as Supernatural Abilities within a tradition, with favored Abilities that avoid the usual study penalty.
quotes: they do not have to subtract the total of their Supernatural Ability scores from their Advancement Total

title: Creating New Traditions
heading: Creating New Traditions
summary: Guidance for designing a new holy tradition, including how to add Methods or Powers and a limit on favored Abilities.
quotes: you should assign your new tradition a maximum of four favored Abilities

title: Holy Tradition: Ascetics
heading: HOLY TRADITION: ASCETICS
summary: A sample generic holy tradition of ascetics, with its favored Abilities and ethos.
quotes: **Favored Abilities:** Adjuration, Cursing, Purity, Second Sight

title: Powers and Effects
heading: Powers and Effects
summary: How a Power's effects are designed: compute range, duration and target like Hermetic magic, replace Arcane Connections with holy connections, and add levels instead of rituals.
quotes: Instead, the Level is increased by 20.
holy effects generally add four magnitudes for a Boundary target, Year duration, or permanent duration

title: Effect Combinations by Method
heading: Effect Combinations by Method
summary: Lists which holy Powers can be activated by each of the three Methods.

title: Effect Combinations by Power
heading: Effect Combinations by Power
summary: Lists which holy Methods can activate each of the seven Powers.

title: Creating New Powers and Effects
heading: Creating New Powers and Effects
summary: Advice for designing new holy effects from Hermetic guidelines or inventing a new Power.

title: Adjuration (Holy Power)
heading: ADJURATION
summary: The Power of summoning, controlling and banishing supernatural creatures, and how Invocation and Purity apply to it.

title: Adjuration Guidelines
heading: Adjuration Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Adjuration effects such as dispelling, warding, binding and compelling supernatural creatures.
quotes: Dispel magic, infernal, or faerie effects of level less than (this effect level + 10).

title: Blessing (Holy Power)
heading: BLESSING
summary: The Power of protecting and aiding a target by dedicating it to God, and how Invocation and Meditation apply to it.

title: Blessing Guidelines
heading: Blessing Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Blessing effects such as Magic Resistance, bonuses to virtuous tasks, recovery and aging bonuses.
quotes: Give a person, object, or area Magic Resistance equal to (the level of the effect + 15), which is not cumulative with other forms of resistance.

title: Cursing (Holy Power)
heading: CURSING
summary: The Power of bringing ruin on God's enemies, and how Invocation and Purity differ in the curses they produce.

title: Cursing Guidelines
heading: Cursing Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Cursing effects such as reducing Might, imposing penalties, wounding, disease and instant death.
quotes: Reduce a supernatural creature's Might by (the level of the effect + 10), assuming you overcome its resistance.

title: Intervention (Holy Power)
heading: INTERVENTION
summary: The Power of making God's will visible in the physical world through signs, transformations and healing, and how Meditation and Purity apply to it.

title: Intervention Guidelines
heading: Intervention Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Intervention effects such as perceiving supernatural effects, transforming or mending things, healing wounds, creating regiones and raising the dead.
quotes: Create a terrestrial regio at level 1. Adding five levels increases the level by one, or adds an extra layer.

title: Transcendence (Holy Power)
heading: TRANSCENDENCE
summary: The Power of overcoming the limits of body and mind, including spiritual travel, and how Meditation and Purity apply to it.

title: Transcendence Guidelines
heading: Transcendence Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Transcendence effects such as protection from spells, extra Soak, ignoring penalties and postponing or resolving aging crises.
quotes: You cannot be targeted by spells or powers less than (the level of this effect + 5).
increasing Soak by (the magnitude of the effect + 3)

title: Understanding (Holy Power)
heading: UNDERSTANDING
summary: The Power of receiving holy visions and hidden knowledge, including the risk of confusion on repeated questions.

title: Understanding Guidelines
heading: Understanding Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Understanding effects such as visions, advice, enhanced memory and prophecy.
quotes: Reduce the number of botch dice you must roll by the magnitude of this effect

title: Wonders (Holy Power)
heading: WONDERS
summary: The Power of conjuring items, creatures and forces of nature through Invocation, and what happens on a tragedy of hubris.

title: Wonders Guidelines
heading: Wonders Guidelines
summary: Effect-level guidelines for Wonders effects such as creating plants, forces of nature, food, objects and animals.
quotes: Create a dangerous substance, like fire or poison, that does +(base level of the spell) damage upon contact.
